title: Kagamine Len — Ways To Get Involved〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Hope Will Someday Go Beyond the Morning

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um... I'm gonna head back to SEKAI for a bit...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sounds good. I'm sure you're still concerned about Mafuyu, so feel free to come back whenever.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay...>
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Len, welcome back...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hi, Miku, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did you get to see Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Just for a little bit.
Actually, what happened was...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu's staying over at Ena's house...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, Ena convinced Mafuyu's mom to let Mafuyu stay the night.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Ena did...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She went through the trouble of bringing Mafuyu over to her house and having her stay over. I have to think that Mafuyu was in a really bad state...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Len...
How was Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um...
She seemed like she was still in some pain...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But she seemed better when Ena and I were talking to her just now compared to the other day when she came over to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what are they doing now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, they're having dinner.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ena said that I could come back whenever, so I think I'll head over in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...
Do any of you want to come with me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, there's no need for me to go if you are.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. We can all go over together, but it's not like there's anything we'll be able to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, Len, you should be the one who stays by their side.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But until then, Len, would you mind telling me more about how Ena and Mafuyu were doing...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, sure. At first, Ena seemed kinda mad at Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But that was actually because she was really worried about her...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you're that concerned, why not just go over and join them...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I was gonna...
But I sort of couldn't after Luka got a hold of me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, where is she...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Seems like Len going to see how they were doing was the right choice. I suppose actions speak louder than words in these sorts of situations.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why's she talking like it was all her idea...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Who knows...? Still...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure he feels a little better after being so worried about Mafuyu and not being able to do much about it until now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Len. He really did wander around aimlessly for quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku seemed rather concerned, and you, Rin, even began following him to see how he was doing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was curious, okay? I mean, he was wandering for so long...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He always causes such a big fuss.
